name: Ramos Pinto
location: Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto, Portugal
description: Founded 1880 by Adriano Ramos Pinto. Known for pioneering Quinta do Bom Retiro as a single-quinta Tawny producer. LVMH acquisition in 1990 brought investment while maintaining production autonomy. The Adriano 30yr and 40yr Tawny are among the finest in the category.

name: Niepoort
location: Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto, Portugal
description: Dutch family house founded 1842; now led by Dirk Niepoort. Produces the definitive Colheita range (single-harvest Tawny) and the legendary Garrafeira Port — wood ageing combined with extended bottle maturation. Holds Colheita stocks from 1934 to the present.
